title: Tier 1 soft reactivity: shader displacement + tool/verb reactions (AUTH #022)
summary: Ship Tier 1 environment reactivity per SPEC §3.6: object segmentation of the splat plus procedural, shader-driven displacement (NO physics -- that is Tier 2/§5). Cushions dent, curtains/plants/paper sway and flutter, cords/soft-hanging swing, dust motes stir -- keyed to the scene graph's segmented objects + material labels, and extended to the new verbs/tools (wall-run dust scuff, rappel curtain sway, grapple twine sway). Must hold the 30 fps target (M3 exit). The Brain-B feedback matrix (material x event reactivity data + validator + tests) is built; the Unity shader-displacement runtime is gj-gameplay.
deliverables: services/reactivity + data/reactivity (reactivity feedback matrix + validator + tests) [claude-builder, done]

acceptance_tests.test: Cushions dent, curtains/plants/paper sway and flutter, and cords swing via shader displacement driven by segmentation + material labels, with no rigid/soft-body physics.
acceptance_tests.evidence: test scene + capture; the per-material displacement map is data/reactivity/reactivity.json (material_response), validated by services/reactivity/tests

acceptance_tests.test: Verb/tool reactions land: a wall-run scuffs dust, a rappel sways a curtain, the grapple twine and its anchor object react on mount.
acceptance_tests.evidence: test scene + capture; the per-event reactions are data/reactivity/reactivity.json (event_reaction), with the wall-run/rappel/grapple cases asserted in services/reactivity/tests

acceptance_tests.test: Tier 1 holds the 30 fps target on the Owner's older reference iPhone with Tier 0 + Tier 1 on (M3 exit test; a suggestion-level measurement, not a merge gate per SPEC §11).

history.event: created by the Coordinator as an AUTH #022 follow-up (Tier 1 soft reactivity).

Brain-B feedback matrix built: services/reactivity + data/reactivity/reactivity.json. material_response (per scene_graph material: displacement none/dent/sway/flutter/swing + stiffness + particle -- fabric/carpet dent, curtain sways, plant/paper flutter, tile/metal/glass rigid) + event_reaction (per verb/tool/landing: particle/haptic/camera_shake/displaces -- wall-run scuff, rappel/grapple react), scale-by-multiplier, 30 fps budget. validate_reactivity enforces coverage of every scene_graph material + every traversal_graph verb; 9 tests prove AT-1 material displacement + AT-2 verb/tool reactions (the data half). Shares the material/verb source of truth with the audio bank; the particle/haptic/shake channels also feed Tier 0 (M1-GAME-03). open -> in-progress. Remaining: the Unity segmentation + displacement shaders + particles + AT-3 device 30 fps (gj-gameplay), which mirrors data/reactivity.

notes: Brain-B reactivity matrix (services/reactivity + data/reactivity) done; the Unity shader-displacement runtime is gj-gameplay.
